title_quote: Have you got a quiet room?

youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Booking a Sleep-Friendly Room
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「好眠房間」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是安靜客房：為了睡好而訂房：先問有沒有遠離電梯與馬路的安靜房、確認遮光窗簾與枕頭，入住時發現房間太吵就換一間，睡前拉好窗簾、關掉噪音，隔天謝謝櫃檯。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Booking a Sleep-Friendly Room' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). Booking a room for a good night's sleep: asking for a quiet room away from the lift and the road, checking the blackout curtains and pillows, moving rooms when it is noisy, and thanking the desk the next morning. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you got a quiet room?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ju ɡɑt ə ˈkwaɪət rum?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have two tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv tu təˈnaɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far is it from the elevator?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ fɑr ɪz ɪt frʌm ði ˈɛləˌveɪtər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is just past the elevator.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz dʒʌst pæst ðə ˈɛləˌveɪtər/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get the one upstairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən aɪ ɡɛt ðə wʌn ˌʌpˈstɛrz?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以要樓上那一間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the sixth floor is quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ðə sɪksθ flɔr ɪz ˈkwaɪət/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the window face the road?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈwɪndoʊ feɪs ðə roʊd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it faces the garden.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt ˈfeɪsɪz ðə ˈɡɑrdən/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you show me this one?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju ʃoʊ mi ðɪs wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 你可以帶我看這一間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's go upstairs now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts ɡoʊ ˌʌpˈstɛrz naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you got many cars outside?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ju ɡɑt ˈmɛni kɑrz ˌaʊtˈsaɪd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not many, the street is small.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈmɛni ðə strit ɪz smɔl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you got rooms off the road?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ju ɡɑt rumz ɔf ðə roʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 你們有遠離馬路的房間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The back ones are quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæk wʌnz ɑr ˈkwaɪət./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the elevator beside that room?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ði ˈɛləˌveɪtər bɪˈsaɪd ðæt rum/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is down the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt ɪz daʊn ðə hɔl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I would like to see both rooms.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tə siː boʊθ ruːmz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, I have both keys.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs aɪ hæv boʊθ kiz/
dialogue.zh: 當然，兩間的鑰匙我都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are they on the same floor?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðeɪ ɑn ðə seɪm flɔr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both are on six.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ɑr ɑn sɪks./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How loud is the air conditioning?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ laʊd ɪz ði ɛr kəndɪʃənɪŋ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bit, but you can lower it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɪt bʌt ju kæn ˈloʊər ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 有一點，不過你可以把它調小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the windows open at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə ˈwɪndoʊz ˈoʊpən æt naɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but only a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt ˈoʊnli ə ˈlɪtəl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we get a higher floor?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd wi ɡɛt ə ˈhaɪər flɔr/
dialogue.zh: 可以要一間高樓層的房間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The seventh floor is free tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɛvənθ flɔr ɪz fri təˈnaɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does a train run near the hotel?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ə treɪn rʌn nɪr ðə hoʊˈtɛl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the station is far away.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə ˈsteɪʃən ɪz fɑr əˈweɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you hear noise from the road?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hɪr nɔɪz frʌm ðə roʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 你聽得到馬路的噪音嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes, so I keep the window closed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz soʊ aɪ kip ðə ˈwɪndoʊ kloʊzd/
dialogue.zh: 有時候會，所以我都把窗戶關著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is any room beside the stairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈɛni rum bɪˈsaɪd ðə stɛrz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: None, they are all further in.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌn ðeɪ ər ɔl ˈfɜrðər ɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you say I can book it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju seɪ aɪ kən bʊk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你覺得我可以訂那間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will hold it for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl hoʊld ɪt fɔr ju./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the walls thick in this hotel?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə wɔlz θɪk ɪn ðɪs hoʊˈtɛl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, most guests sleep well.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs moʊst ɡɛsts slip wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 厚，大部分客人都睡得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we find a bar downstairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi faɪnd ə bɑr ˌdaʊnˈstɛrz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but it closes at eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt ɪt ˈkloʊzɪz æt ɪˈlɛvən/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a twin room?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ə twɪn rum/
dialogue.zh: 你們有兩張床的房間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am afraid the twins are full.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm əˈfreɪd ðə twɪnz ər fʊl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any chance of a quieter one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni tʃæns əv ə ˈkwaɪətər wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 有機會換到更安靜的一間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, let me check the list.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə lɪst/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does floor six get noisy at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz flɔr sɪks gɛt ˈnɔɪzi æt naɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is very quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt ɪz ˈvɛri ˈkwaɪət/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the guests quiet on that side?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə ɡɛsts ˈkwaɪət ɑn ðæt saɪd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly, they sleep early there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli ðeɪ slip ˈɜrli ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 大多很安靜，他們在那邊都早睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you got rooms at the back?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ju ɡɑt rumz æt ðə bæk?/
dialogue.zh: 你們後面那側有房間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two of them are free.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu əv ðɛm ɑr fri./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does floor six stay away from traffic?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz flɔr sɪks steɪ əˈweɪ frʌm træfɪk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The back side is quieter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæk saɪd ɪz ˈkwaɪətər/
dialogue.zh: 靠後面那一側比較安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'd like a double room, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /wid laɪk ə ˈdʌbəl rum pliz/
dialogue.zh: 我們想要一間雙人房，麻煩你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a double with a garden view.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə ˈdʌbəl wɪð ə ˈɡɑrdən vju/
dialogue.zh: 好的，一間面花園的雙人房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How big is the double room?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ bɪg ɪz ðə ˈdʌbəl rum?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's big enough for two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts bɪɡ ɪˈnʌf fɔr tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Between us, a back room please.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈtwiːn ʌs ə bæk ruːm pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 私下說，請給我們一間後面的房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will pick one for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl pɪk wʌn fɔr ju./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is any room near the ice machine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈɛni rum nɪr ði aɪs məˈʃin/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: None, they are all far.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌn ðeɪ ər ɔl fɑr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you got a floor map?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ju ɡɑt ə flɔr mæp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is a small one.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ə smɔl wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the road get busy early?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə roʊd gɛt ˈbɪzi ˈɜrli?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The back side works better.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæk saɪd wɜrks ˈbɛtər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would three nights be all right?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd θriː naɪts biː ɔːl raɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, the room is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs ðə rum ɪz fri/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is a double room?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ə ˈdʌbəl rum?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's three thousand one hundred a night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts θri ˈθaʊzənd wʌn ˈhʌndrəd ə naɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that price include breakfast?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðæt praɪs ɪnˈklud ˈbrɛkfəst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, breakfast is included.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈbrɛkfəst ɪz ɪnˈkludɪd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay when I leave?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ peɪ wɛn aɪ liv?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以退房時再付款嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can pay tomorrow morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn peɪ təˈmɑroʊ ˈmɔrnɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I need to leave a deposit?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl aɪ nid tu liv ə dɪˈpɑzɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we don't need one.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wi doʊnt nid wʌn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would a quieter room cost more?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ə ˈkwaɪətər rum kɔst mɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 安靜一點的房間會比較貴嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the price is the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə praɪs ɪz ðə seɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you still have that one tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju stɪl hæv ðæt wʌn təˈnaɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can hold it now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn hoʊld ɪt naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I write my name here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ raɪt maɪ neɪm hɪr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please write your phone number too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz raɪt jɔr foʊn ˈnʌmbər tu/
dialogue.zh: 是的，請也寫上你的電話號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need my passport now?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju nid maɪ ˈpæspɔrt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 你現在需要我的護照嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, just for one minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs dʒʌst fɔr wʌn ˈmɪnɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will that one be ready for us?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðæt wʌn bi ˈrɛdi fɔr ʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 那一間會為我們準備好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, the cleaner is inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt ðə ˈklinər ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we able to wait here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑː wiː ˈeɪbəl tə weɪt hɪə/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the sofa is very soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ðə ˈsoʊfə ɪz ˈvɛri sɔft/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How quiet is the lobby at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈkwaɪət ɪz ðə ˈlɑbi æt naɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: After ten it is silent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftər tɛn ɪt ɪz ˈsaɪlənt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you got rooms with bathtubs?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ju ɡɑt rumz wɪð bæθtʌbz?/
dialogue.zh: 你們有附浴缸的房間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but only on the fourth floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt ˈoʊnli ɑn ðə fɔrθ flɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does floor four stay far from traffic?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz flɔr fɔr steɪ fɑr frʌm træfɪk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it faces the back garden.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt ˈfeɪsɪz ðə bæk ˈɡɑrdən/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you keep our bags here?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl juː kiːp ˈaʊə bæɡz hɪə/
dialogue.zh: 你可以幫我們保管行李嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, behind the front desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bɪˈhaɪnd ðə frʌnt dɛsk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe we take the lift to six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbiː wiː teɪk ðə lɪft tə sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 也許我們搭電梯到六樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lift is on your right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɪft ɪz ɑn jɔr raɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you got rooms off the lift?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ju ɡɑt rumz ɔf ðə lɪft?/
dialogue.zh: 你們有遠離電梯的房間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six oh two is still free.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks oʊ tu ɪz stɪl fri./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How quiet is room six oh two?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈkwaɪət ɪz rum sɪks oʊ tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is the quietest room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ðə ˈkwaɪətɪst rum/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we see room six oh two?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd wi si rum sɪks oʊ tu?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以看六零二號房嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, let's take the lift up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr lɛts teɪk ðə lɪft ʌp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you tell me the room number?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən juː tɛl miː ðə ruːm ˈnʌmbər/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is six oh two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz sɪks oʊ tu./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that one on the sixth floor?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt wʌn ɑn ðə sɪksθ flɔr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six oh two is on six.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks oʊ tu ɪz ɑn sɪks./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the room fit two people?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə rum fɪt tu ˈpipəl?/
dialogue.zh: 這間房兩個人住夠大嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, there is space for two.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðɛr ɪz speɪs fɔr tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I open the window wide?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ ˈoʊpən ðə ˈwɪndoʊ waɪd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but the road is loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt ðə roʊd ɪz laʊd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the window have a curtain?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈwɪndoʊ hæv ə ˈkɜrtən?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and it is very thick.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ɪt ɪz ˈvɛri θɪk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the curtains block the street light?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə ˈkɜrtənz blɑk ðə strit laɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They block it very well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ blɑk ɪt ˈvɛri wɛl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are they blackout curtains?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðeɪ ˈblækˌaʊt ˈkɜrtənz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every one has blackout curtains.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri wʌn hæz ˈblækˌaʊt ˈkɜrtənz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about a lamp beside the bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ə læmp bɪˈsaɪd ðə bɛd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a small lamp on each side.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə smɔl læmp ɑn itʃ saɪd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you got soft and firm pillows?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ju ɡɑt sɔft ænd fɜrm ˈpɪloʊz?/
dialogue.zh: 你們有軟的和硬的枕頭嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have both kinds here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv boʊθ kaɪndz hɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want a softer pillow tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt ə ˈsɔftər ˈpɪloʊ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我今晚想要一個軟一點的枕頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll bring one soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr aɪl brɪŋ wʌn sun/
dialogue.zh: 當然，我馬上送一個過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the pillow on the bed firm?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈpɪloʊ ɑn ðə bɛd fɜrm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can change it for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn tʃeɪndʒ ɪt fɔr ju./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you got a neck pillow?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ju ɡɑt ə nɛk ˈpɪloʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the firm one helps your neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə fɜrm wʌn hɛlps jɔr nɛk/
dialogue.zh: 有，硬的那個對脖子有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would two soft pillows be too many?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd tu sɔft ˈpɪloʊz bi tu ˈmɛni?/
dialogue.zh: 兩個軟枕頭會不會太多？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, two is fine for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ tu ɪz faɪn fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 不會，兩個對你來說剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, is the bed wide or small?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪz ðə bɛd waɪd ɔr smɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 這張床是寬的還是小的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is wide, a queen size.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz waɪd ə kwin saɪz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How about one extra blanket?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ əˈbaʊt wʌn ˈɛkstrə ˈblæŋkɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, it is in the closet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ɪt ɪz ɪn ðə ˈklɑzɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, is the closet near the bathroom?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ɪz ðə ˈklɑzɪt nɪr ðə ˈbæθrum?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is beside the bathroom door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz bɪˈsaɪd ðə ˈbæθrum dɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does room eight oh one have twins?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz rum eɪt oʊ wʌn hæv twɪnz?/
dialogue.zh: 八零一號房的床是兩張單人床嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that room has one big bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðæt rum hæz wʌn bɪɡ bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 不是，那間房只有一張大床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two twin beds would be better.
dialogue.phonetic: /tuː twɪn bɛdz wʊd biː ˈbɛtər/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm sorry, the twins are all taken.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈsɑri ðə twɪnz ɑr ɔl ˈteɪkən/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，單人床房都訂滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are all the twin rooms booked tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ɔl ðə twɪn rumz bʊkt təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 今晚所有單人床房都訂完了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a group took them all.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə ɡrup tʊk ðɛm ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 對，一個團體把它們全訂走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you got any other room type?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ju ɡɑt ˈɛni ˈʌðər rum taɪp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the double room on four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə ˈdʌbəl rum ɑn fɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, is that double room still free?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ɪz ðæt ˈdʌbəl rum stɪl fri?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is free for three nights.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt ɪz fri fɔr θri naɪts/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I take that double room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ teɪk ðæt ˈdʌbəl ruːm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let me write your name.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs lɛt mi raɪt jɔr neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 可以，讓我記下你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would the price stay the same?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ðə praɪs steɪ ðə seɪm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, three thousand one hundred a night.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs θri ˈθaʊzənd wʌn ˈhʌndrəd ə naɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And, is the fourth floor quiet too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪz ðə fɔrθ flɔr ˈkwaɪət tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very quiet, it faces the garden.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri ˈkwaɪət ɪt ˈfeɪsɪz ðə ˈɡɑrdən/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do those rooms have blackout curtains?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðoʊz rumz hæv ˈblækˌaʊt ˈkɜrtənz?/
dialogue.zh: 那些房間有遮光窗簾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and soft pillows too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd sɔft ˈpɪloʊz tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that one have a queen bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðæt wʌn hæv ə kwin bɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 那一間有加大雙人床嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bed is very wide.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛd ɪz ˈvɛri waɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, I want to see that one.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst aɪ wɑnt tə siː ðæt wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, follow me please.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs ˈfɑloʊ mi pliz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, is this the fourth floor?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪz ðɪs ðə fɔrθ flɔr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is on four.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt ɪz ɑn fɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you open the door for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju ˈoʊpən ðə dɔr fɔr mi?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here are your two keys.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɑr jɔr tu kiz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, is the window facing the garden?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ɪz ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ˈfeɪsɪŋ ðə ˈɡɑrdən?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, only trees and small birds.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈoʊnli triz ænd smɔl bɜrdz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the curtains close all the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə ˈkɜrtənz kloʊz ɔl ðə weɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They meet in the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ mit ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the pillows on the bed soft?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə ˈpɪloʊz ɑn ðə bɛd sɔft?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two soft ones are here.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu sɔft wʌnz ɑr hɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the bed away from the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə bɛd əˈweɪ frʌm ðə dɔr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sits by the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɪts baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will two more pillows be enough?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl tuː mɔr ˈpɪloʊz biː ɪˈnʌf/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll bring them up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr aɪl brɪŋ ðɛm ʌp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And, is the air conditioning working well?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪz ði ɛr kənˈdɪʃənɪŋ ˈwɜrkɪŋ wɛl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fan is a bit loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fæn ɪz ə bɪt laʊd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I turn the air down?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ tɜrn ði ɛr daʊn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the dial is on the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈdaɪəl ɪz ɑn ðə wɔl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the fridge make any noise?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə frɪdʒ meɪk ˈɛni nɔɪz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, but it is very low.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl bʌt ɪt ɪz ˈvɛri loʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a machine running near this room?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ə məˈʃin ˈrʌnɪŋ nɪr ðɪs rum?/
dialogue.zh: 這間房附近有吵雜的機器嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the machines are downstairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə məˈʃinz ɑr ˌdaʊnˈstɛrz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it possible to move tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ˈpɒsəbəl tə muːv təˈnaɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only tomorrow morning works.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli təˈmɑroʊ ˈmɔrnɪŋ wɜrks./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would tomorrow morning be too late?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd təˈmɑroʊ ˈmɔrnɪŋ bi tu leɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I'll call you at eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ aɪl kɔl ju æt eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不會，我八點打電話給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I keep my phone on?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kip maɪ foʊn ɑn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please keep it near you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz kip ɪt nɪr ju/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, is the deposit still not needed?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ɪz ðə dɪˈpɑzɪt stɪl nɑt ˈnidɪd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, no deposit is needed tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt noʊ dɪˈpɑzɪt ɪz ˈnidɪd təˈnaɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the price include the blackout curtains?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə praɪs ɪnˈklud ðə ˈblækˌaʊt ˈkɜrtənz?/
dialogue.zh: 這個價格包含遮光窗簾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each one has them here.
dialogue.phonetic: /itʃ wʌn hæz ðɛm hɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I book three nights here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd aɪ bʊk θriː naɪts hɪə/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在這裡訂三晚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three nights is fine for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri naɪts ɪz faɪn fɔr ʌs/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the total nine thousand three hundred?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈtoʊtəl naɪn ˈθaʊzənd θri ˈhʌndrəd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, nine thousand three hundred in all.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs naɪn ˈθaʊzənd θri ˈhʌndrəd ɪn ɔl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay now or at checkout?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ peɪ naʊ ɔr æt ˈtʃɛkˌaʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在付還是退房時付？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At checkout is fine for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt ˈtʃɛkˌaʊt ɪz faɪn fɔr ʌs/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you write the price down?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd juː raɪt ðə praɪs daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 你可以把價格寫下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, here is your copy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr hɪr ɪz jɔr ˈkɑpi/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the phone number on the paper?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə foʊn ˈnʌmbər ɑn ðə ˈpeɪpər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The front desk number is there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə frʌnt dɛsk ˈnʌmbər ɪz ðɛr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you send me an email?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju sɛnd mi ən ˈimeɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 你會寄電子郵件給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will send it after booking.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl sɛnd ɪt ˈæftər ˈbʊkɪŋ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I write my email here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ raɪt maɪ ˈimeɪl hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我要把電子郵件寫在這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please write it clearly for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz raɪt ɪt ˈklɪrli fɔr mi/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we in room four oh two?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr wi ɪn rum fɔr oʊ tu?/
dialogue.zh: 我們住的是四零二房嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, four oh two is yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs fɔr oʊ tu ɪz jʊrz/
dialogue.zh: 是的，四樓四零二房是你們的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we check this one again?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi tʃɛk ðɪs wʌn əˈɡɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要再看一次這一間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it has one queen bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt hæz wʌn kwin bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 對，它是一張加大雙人床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was the twin room sold out today?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz ðə twɪn rum soʊld aʊt təˈdeɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A big group took every twin room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɪɡ ɡrup tʊk ˈɛvri twɪn rum/
dialogue.zh: 有一個大團體把所有雙床房都訂走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need my name on this?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju nid maɪ neɪm ɑn ðɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 這張需要寫上我的名字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please sign here and take your key.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz saɪn hir ænd teɪk jʊr ki/
dialogue.zh: 請在這裡簽名，然後拿您的鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would breakfast still start at seven?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ˈbrɛkfəst stɪl stɑrt æt ˈsɛvən?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It starts at seven on floor two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɑrts æt ˈsɛvən ɑn flɔr tu./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we pay when we check out?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi peɪ wɛn wi tʃɛk aʊt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, you pay at check-out time.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ju peɪ æt tʃɛk aʊt taɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will we need a deposit here?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl wi nid ə dɪˈpɑzɪt hɪr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we need no deposit at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wi nid noʊ dɪˈpɑzɪt æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 不用，我們完全不需要押金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has the price changed since we booked?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæz ðə praɪs tʃeɪndʒd sɪns wi bʊkt?/
dialogue.zh: 從我們訂房到現在價格有變嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is three thousand one hundred.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt ɪz θri ˈθaʊzənd wʌn ˈhʌndrəd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those blinds really blackout ones?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðoʊz blaɪndz ˈrɪəli ˈblækaʊt wʌnz?/
dialogue.zh: 那些窗簾真的是遮光的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they keep the morning sun out.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðeɪ kip ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ sʌn aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 是的，它們能把早晨的陽光擋在外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we get soft pillows here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi gɛt sɔft ˈpɪloʊz hɪr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two soft pillows wait there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu sɔft ˈpɪloʊz weɪt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 有，兩個軟枕頭就放在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any chance of two more pillows?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈeni tʃɑːns əv tuː mɔr ˈpɪloʊz/
dialogue.zh: 可以再多要兩個枕頭嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, we will bring firm ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs wi wɪl brɪŋ fɜrm wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 當然，我們會送硬的枕頭上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you check the hallway now?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju tʃɛk ðə ˈhɔlˌweɪ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你可以現在確認一下走廊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is quiet, the elevator is far.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈkwaɪət ði ˈɛləˌveɪtər ɪz fɑr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was six oh two facing the garden?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz sɪks oʊ tu ˈfeɪsɪŋ ðə ˈɡɑrdən?/
dialogue.zh: 六樓六零二房是在花園那一側嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it faces the garden.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt ˈfeɪsɪz ðə ˈɡɑrdən/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we move if it stays loud?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi muv ɪf ɪt steɪz laʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 如果一直很吵，我們應該換房嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell the desk and we'll move you.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl ðə dɛsk ænd wil muv ju/
dialogue.zh: 跟櫃台說一聲，我們會幫你們換房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we switch to a quieter one?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi swɪtʃ tu ə ˈkwaɪətər wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以換到更安靜的一間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me look for a quiet room.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi lʊk fɔr ə ˈkwaɪət rum./
dialogue.zh: 我來找一間安靜的房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would the room upstairs be any quieter?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ðə rum ˌʌpˈstɛrz bi ˈɛni ˈkwaɪətər?/
dialogue.zh: 樓上的房間會比較安靜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Upstairs is quieter, I can hold one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌpˈstɛrz ɪz ˈkwaɪətər aɪ kæn hoʊld wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 樓上比較安靜，我可以幫您留一間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I see it before deciding?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd aɪ siː ɪt bɪˈfɔr dɪˈsaɪdɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在決定前看看那間房嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the bell staff can show you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ðə bɛl stæf kæn ʃoʊ ju/
dialogue.zh: 當然，行李員可以帶您去看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four oh two feels quiet enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr oʊ tu filz ˈkwaɪət ɪˈnʌf./
dialogue.zh: 四零二房已經夠安靜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then nothing needs to change.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðɛn ˈnʌθɪŋ nidz tu tʃeɪndʒ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I call the desk about noise?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kɔl ðə dɛsk əˈbaʊt nɔɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 我該打電話跟櫃台說噪音的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, we can move you tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du wi kæn muv ju təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 請打，我們今晚可以幫你們換房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we pay extra for quiet rooms?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi peɪ ˈɛkstrə fɔr ˈkwaɪət rumz?/
dialogue.zh: 換安靜的房間要加錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, a quiet room costs the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ə ˈkwaɪət rum kɔsts ðə seɪm/
dialogue.zh: 不用，安靜的房間價格一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has the floor plan changed at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæz ðə flɔr plæn tʃeɪndʒd æt ɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 樓層配置有任何變動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, four oh two faces the garden.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ fɔr oʊ tu ˈfeɪsɪz ðə ˈɡɑrdən/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，四零二房還是面向花園。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would housekeeping bring some earplugs up?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ˈhaʊskipɪŋ brɪŋ sʌm ˈɪrplʌɡz ʌp?/
dialogue.zh: 房務人員可以送耳塞上來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will ask them to send earplugs.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl æsk ðɛm tu sɛnd ˈɪrplʌɡz/
dialogue.zh: 我會請他們送耳塞上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you keep earplugs behind the desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju kip ˈɪrplʌɡz bɪˈhaɪnd ðə dɛsk?/
dialogue.zh: 你們櫃台後面有耳塞嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, here is a soft pair.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du hir ɪz ə sɔft pɛr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wear earplugs every night here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ wɛr ˈɪrplʌɡz ˈɛvri naɪt hir?/
dialogue.zh: 我在這裡每晚都要戴耳塞嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if the road noise bothers you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ðə roʊd nɔɪz ˈbɑðərz ju/
dialogue.zh: 只有在馬路噪音吵到您時才需要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way to the room is quieter?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ weɪ tu ðə rum ɪz ˈkwaɪətər?/
dialogue.zh: 有比較安靜的路線到房間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the back stairs, they stay silent.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə bæk stɛrz ðeɪ steɪ ˈsaɪlənt/
dialogue.zh: 走後面樓梯，那裡一直很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you note the eight o'clock call?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju noʊt ði eɪt əˈklɑk kɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 你們記下八點的叫醒電話了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the desk calls at eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə dɛsk kɔlz æt eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，櫃台八點會打來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they knock if the phone dies?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðeɪ nɑk ɪf ðə foʊn daɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 如果電話壞了，他們會敲門嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They will, and they knock quite softly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɪl ænd ðeɪ nɑk kwaɪt ˈsɔftli/
dialogue.zh: 會的，而且他們敲門很輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the window open in our place?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ˈoʊpən ɪn ɑr pleɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 我們房裡的窗戶是開著的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was closed, but I opened it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wʌz kloʊzd bʌt aɪ ˈoʊpənd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 本來是關著的，但我打開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the air hum at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ði ɛr hʌm æt naɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If it hums, please tell us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ɪt hʌmz pliz tɛl ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 如果嗡嗡響，請告訴我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you got a fan to borrow?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ju ɡɑt ə fæn tu ˈbɑroʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 你們有電風扇可以借我們嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We keep two fans at the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kip tu fænz æt ðə dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 我們櫃台放了兩台電風扇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I keep the curtains shut?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kip ðə ˈkɜrtənz ʃʌt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, the street lights are bright.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du ðə strit laɪts ɑr braɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the pillows soft enough?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə ˈpɪloʊz sɔft ɪˈnʌf?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are soft, the firm ones wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑr sɔft ðə fɜrm wʌnz weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 它們很軟，硬的枕頭也備著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the bed fit a tall man?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə bɛd fɪt ə tɔl mæn?/
dialogue.zh: 這張床睡得下一個高個子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does, guests say it feels long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz ɡɛsts seɪ ɪt filz lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 夠長，客人說這床感覺很長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you bring two bottles of water?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju brɪŋ tu ˈbɑtəlz əv ˈwɔtər?/
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我們拿兩瓶水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two bottles come up in a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈbɑtəlz kʌm ʌp ɪn ə ˈmɪnɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has the room been cleaned this afternoon?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæz ðə rum bɪn klind ðɪs ˌæftərˈnun?/
dialogue.zh: 這間房間今天下午打掃過了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it was cleaned before you arrived.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt wʌz klind bɪˈfɔr ju əˈraɪvd/
dialogue.zh: 打掃過了，在您抵達之前就打掃好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the neighbors keep the television loud?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə ˈneɪbərz kip ðə ˈtɛləvɪʒən laʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 隔壁房的電視會開很大聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They never do, the walls stay thick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈnɛvər du ðə wɔlz steɪ θɪk/
dialogue.zh: 從來不會，這裡的牆很厚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May we leave the hallway light off?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ wiː liːv ðə ˈhɔːlweɪ laɪt ɒf/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以讓走廊的燈關著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That light stays on for safety reasons.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt laɪt steɪz ɑn fɔr ˈseɪfti ˈrizənz/
dialogue.zh: 那盞燈為了安全必須一直開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has the bathroom fan stopped?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæz ðə ˈbæθrum fæn stɑpt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, so switch it off.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt soʊ swɪtʃ ɪt ɔf/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When does the breakfast room close?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn dʌz ðə ˈbrɛkfəst rum kloʊz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It closes at ten every morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈkloʊzɪz æt tɛn ˈɛvri ˈmɔrnɪŋ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any chance I charge my phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈeni tʃɑːns aɪ tʃɑrdʒ maɪ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 有機會讓我幫手機充電嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a plug on each side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə plʌɡ ɑn itʃ saɪd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would staff knock if we sleep late?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd stæf nɑk ɪf wi slip leɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我們睡晚了，員工會敲門嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will not knock before ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl nɑt nɑk bɪˈfɔr tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 我們十點前都不會敲門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you got blankets in the closet?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ju ɡɑt ˈblæŋkɪts ɪn ðə ˈklɑzɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One extra blanket is on the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈɛkstrə ˈblæŋkɪt ɪz ɑn ðə ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 架子上有一條備用毯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the wifi good on this floor?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈwaɪfaɪ ɡʊd ɑn ðɪs flɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 這一層的無線網路好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is strong, the router sits nearby.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz strɔŋ ðə ˈraʊtər sɪts nɪrˈbaɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you email the bill over?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd juː ˈiːmeɪl ðə bɪl ˈoʊvər/
dialogue.zh: 可以把帳單寄電子郵件過來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will send it to your inbox.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl sɛnd ɪt tu jʊr ˈɪnbɑks/
dialogue.zh: 我會寄到您的電子信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the shower stay warm all evening?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈʃaʊər steɪ wɔrm ɔl ˈivnɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 淋浴的水整晚都夠熱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stays warm, guests never complain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt steɪz wɔrm ɡɛsts ˈnɛvər kəmˈpleɪn/
dialogue.zh: 一直都很熱，客人都沒抱怨過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we allowed to move the table?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr wi əˈlaʊd tu muv ðə ˈteɪbəl?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以把桌子移開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, move anything you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs muv ˈɛniθɪŋ ju laɪk/
dialogue.zh: 當然，您想移什麼都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I report the road noise now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ rɪˈpɔrt ðə roʊd nɔɪz naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在就該反映馬路噪音嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and we will note your room.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd wi wɪl noʊt jʊr rum/
dialogue.zh: 是的，我們會記下您的房號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would the manager refund a noisy night?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ðə ˈmænɪdʒər rɪˈfʌnd ə ˈnɔɪzi naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 經理會退還吵鬧那一晚的費用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He can, if noise keeps you awake.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi kæn ɪf nɔɪz kips ju əˈweɪk/
dialogue.zh: 如果噪音讓您睡不著，他可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would there be a quiet corner?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ðɛr bi ə ˈkwaɪət ˈkɔrnər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The garden bench is always quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈɡɑrdən bɛntʃ ɪz ˈɔlweɪz ˈkwaɪət/
dialogue.zh: 花園的長椅總是很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we get one more key?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd wiː ɡɛt wʌn mɔr kiː/
dialogue.zh: 可以再給我們一張房卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go, two keys.
dialogue.phonetic: /hir ju ɡoʊ tu kiz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we close the blackout curtains now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi kloʊz ðə ˈblækaʊt ˈkɜrtənz naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們現在該把遮光窗簾拉上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the street lights are coming on.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə strit laɪts ɑr ˈkʌmɪŋ ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 該拉了，路燈已經亮起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you pull the curtains shut?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju pʊl ðə ˈkɜrtənz ʃʌt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I did, there is no gap left.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd ðɛr ɪz noʊ ɡæp lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 拉了，沒有留下任何縫隙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you check the sides once more?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju tʃɛk ðə saɪdz wʌns mɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 你可以再檢查一次兩側嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sides are tight against the frame.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə saɪdz ɑr taɪt əˈɡɛnst ðə freɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the curtains heavy enough for daylight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə ˈkɜrtənz ˈhɛvi ɪˈnʌf fɔr ˈdeɪlaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 這窗簾夠厚，能擋住日光嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are, the room stays dark inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑr ðə rum steɪz dɑrk ɪnˈsaɪd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has the air conditioning been turned off?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæz ði ɛr kənˈdɪʃənɪŋ bɪn tɜrnd ɔf?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I turned it off, the hum stopped.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tɜrnd ɪt ɔf ðə hʌm stɑpt/
dialogue.zh: 我關掉了，嗡嗡聲就停了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the hum stop when turned off?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə hʌm stɑp wɛn tɜrnd ɔf?/
dialogue.zh: 關掉之後，嗡嗡聲停了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stopped, the room is silent now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɑpt ðə rum ɪz ˈsaɪlənt naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the window safe to open?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈwɪndoʊ seɪf tu ˈoʊpən/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little air would help us sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl ɛr wʊd hɛlp ʌs slip/
dialogue.zh: 一點空氣會幫助我們入睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the traffic die down later?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə ˈtræfɪk daɪ daʊn ˈleɪtər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A truck passes, then it settles down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə trʌk ˈpæsɪz ðɛn ɪt ˈsɛtəlz daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 有卡車經過，之後就平息了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the earplugs still on the nightstand?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ði ˈɪrplʌɡz stɪl ɑn ðə ˈnaɪtstænd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are, right beside your glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑr raɪt bɪˈsaɪd jʊr ɡlæs/
dialogue.zh: 還在，就在你的杯子旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you able to do both ears?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑː juː ˈeɪbəl tə duː boʊθ ɪrz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I did, the room sounds softer now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd ðə rum saʊndz ˈsɔftər naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 塞好了，房間的聲音現在聽起來柔和多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we set the alarm for seven?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi sɛt ði əˈlɑrm fɔr ˈsɛvən?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要把鬧鐘設在七點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven works, breakfast starts at seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən wɜrks ˈbrɛkfəst stɑrts æt ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 七點可以，早餐七點開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has the front desk called us yet?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæz ðə frʌnt dɛsk kɔld ʌs jɛt?/
dialogue.zh: 櫃台已經打給我們了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, it is only eight now.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt ɪt ɪz ˈoʊnli eɪt naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which pillow do you want tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈpɪloʊ du ju wɑnt təˈnaɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will take the soft one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl teɪk ðə sɔft wʌn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the bed comfortable on your side?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə bɛd ˈkʌmfərtəbəl ɑn jʊr saɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 你那邊的床睡起來舒服嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, the queen bed feels wide.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ðə kwin bɛd filz waɪd/
dialogue.zh: 很舒服，這張加大雙人床感覺很寬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe we keep the bathroom light off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbiː wiː kiːp ðə ˈbæθrum laɪt ɒf/
dialogue.zh: 也許我們讓浴室的燈關著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us turn it off and sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs tɜrn ɪt ɔf ænd slip/
dialogue.zh: 我們把它關掉，然後睡吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the phone set to silent mode?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə foʊn sɛt tu ˈsaɪlənt moʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 手機設定成靜音模式了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, nothing should wake us early.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈnʌθɪŋ ʃʊd weɪk ʌs ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 設好了，不該有任何東西太早吵醒我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are your eyes already getting heavy?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr jʊr aɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈhɛvi?/
dialogue.zh: 你的眼睛已經睜不開了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are, I am very sleepy now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑr aɪ æm ˈvɛri ˈslipi naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we leave the curtains closed tomorrow?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃæl wi liv ðə ˈkɜrtənz kloʊzd təˈmɑroʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們明天也讓窗簾關著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave them, we can open them later.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ðɛm wi kæn ˈoʊpən ðɛm ˈleɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 就讓它關著，我們之後再打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you wake if a car passes?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju weɪk ɪf ə kɑr ˈpæsɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 如果有車經過，你會醒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With earplugs in, I sleep through.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð ˈɪrplʌɡz ɪn aɪ slip θru/
dialogue.zh: 塞著耳塞，我會一覺睡過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I turn off the reading lamp?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ tɜrn ɔf ðə ˈridɪŋ læmp?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以關掉床前閱讀燈嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, the room is dark enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd ðə rum ɪz dɑrk ɪˈnʌf/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the clock bright in the dark?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə klɑk braɪt ɪn ðə dɑrk?/
dialogue.zh: 時鐘在黑暗中會很亮嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It glows a little, not too much.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɡloʊz ə ˈlɪtəl nɑt tu mʌtʃ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you like a glass of water?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju laɪk ə ɡlæs əv ˈwɔtər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not now, maybe after I wake.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt naʊ ˈmeɪbi ˈæftər aɪ weɪk/
dialogue.zh: 現在不用，也許醒來之後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we say goodnight to the desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi seɪ ˈɡʊdnaɪt tu ðə dɛsk?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要跟櫃台說晚安嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No need, they already said goodnight.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ nid ðeɪ ɔlˈrɛdi sɛd ˈɡʊdnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不用，他們已經說過晚安了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you ready for bed now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ˈrɛdi fɔr bɛd naʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let us sleep now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs lɛt ʌs slip naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you hear anything from the hallway?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hɪr ˈɛniθɪŋ frʌm ðə ˈhɔlweɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 你聽到走廊那邊有什麼聲音嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing at all, this floor is empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ æt ɔl ðɪs flɔr ɪz ˈɛmpti/
dialogue.zh: 什麼都沒有，這層樓是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was your sleep good in our room?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz jʊr slip ɡʊd ɪn aʊr rum?/
dialogue.zh: 你在我們房間睡得好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I slept straight through until seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ slɛpt streɪt θru ʌnˈtɪl ˈsɛvən/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was the room quiet all night long?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz ðə rum ˈkwaɪət ɔl naɪt lɔŋ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I heard nothing at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɜrd ˈnʌθɪŋ æt ɔl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the morning call come at eight?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ kɔl kʌm æt eɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 早上的叫醒電話八點來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It came right at eight, very gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt keɪm raɪt æt eɪt ˈvɛri ˈdʒɛntli/
dialogue.zh: 八點準時來了，聲音很輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you feeling rested this morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ˈfilɪŋ ˈrɛstɪd ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 你今天早上覺得休息夠了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I feel great, that bed was perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fil ɡreɪt ðæt bɛd wʌz ˈpɜrfɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 我覺得很好，那張床太完美了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall I open the curtains for light?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃæl aɪ ˈoʊpən ðə ˈkɜrtənz fɔr laɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 要我拉開窗簾讓光進來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, the garden looks lovely today.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du ðə ˈɡɑrdən lʊks ˈlʌvli təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 拉開吧，今天花園看起來很美。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you see the garden from here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju si ðə ˈɡɑrdən frʌm hir?/
dialogue.zh: 你從這裡看得到花園嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can, the flowers are opening up.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn ðə ˈflaʊɚz ɑr ˈoʊpənɪŋ ʌp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want to go eat breakfast?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt tu ɡoʊ it ˈbrɛkfəst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us go before it gets crowded.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs ɡoʊ bɪˈfɔr ɪt ɡɛts ˈkraʊdɪd/
dialogue.zh: 我們在人變多之前去吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is breakfast still on the second floor?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈbrɛkfəst stɪl ɑn ðə ˈsɛkənd flɔr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, near the sunny windows.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz nɪr ðə ˈsʌni ˈwɪndoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 是的，就在陽光充足的窗邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you grab the room key card?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju ɡræb ðə rum ki kɑrd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have both keys in my pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv boʊθ kiz ɪn maɪ ˈpɑkɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we tell the desk about noise?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi tɛl ðə dɛsk əˈbaʊt nɔɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 我們該跟櫃台說噪音的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No need, the earplugs solved everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ nid ði ˈɪrplʌɡz sɑlvd ˈɛvriθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 不用了，耳塞就解決了一切。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did housekeeping bring the extra pillows?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ˈhaʊskipɪŋ brɪŋ ði ˈɛkstrə ˈpɪloʊz?/
dialogue.zh: 房務有把備用枕頭送來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They did, right after we asked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ dɪd raɪt ˈæftər wi æskt/
dialogue.zh: 送來了，就在我們詢問之後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we paying at check-out today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr wi ˈpeɪɪŋ æt tʃɛk aʊt təˈde?/
dialogue.zh: 我們今天退房時付款嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, nine thousand three hundred in total.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs naɪn ˈθaʊzənd θri ˈhʌndrəd ɪn ˈtoʊtəl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many nights did we stay here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni naɪts dɪd wi steɪ hir?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three nights at three thousand one hundred.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri naɪts æt θri ˈθaʊzənd wʌn ˈhʌndrəd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it possible to print the bill?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ˈpɒsəbəl tə prɪnt ðə bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我們列印帳單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They will print it at check-out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɪl prɪnt ɪt æt tʃɛk aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 退房時他們會印給我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has the manager heard about our room?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæz ðə ˈmænɪdʒər hɜrd əˈbaʊt aʊr rum?/
dialogue.zh: 經理知道我們房間的事了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He has, and he is pleased.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi hæz ænd hi ɪz plizd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you think we should come back?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju θɪŋk wi ʃʊd kʌm bæk?/
dialogue.zh: 你覺得我們應該再回來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I would, this hotel is worth it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd ðɪs hoʊˈtɛl ɪz wɜrθ ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got time for one more coffee?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt taɪm fɔr wʌn mɔr ˈkɔfi/
dialogue.zh: 還有時間再喝一杯咖啡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is, we have until eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz wi hæv ʌnˈtɪl ɪˈlɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 有，我們可以待到十一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you pack my earplugs?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju pæk maɪ ˈɪrplʌɡz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already in there, beside your book.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈrɛdi ɪn ðɛr bɪˈsaɪd jʊr bʊk/
dialogue.zh: 已經放進去了，就在你的書旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I thank the housekeeping staff personally?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ θæŋk ðə ˈhaʊskipɪŋ stæf ˈpɜrsənəli?/
dialogue.zh: 我該親自謝謝房務人員嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That would be kind, they worked late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʊd bi kaɪnd ðeɪ wɜrkt leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那樣很好，他們工作到很晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was the road noise bad last night?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz ðə roʊd nɔɪz bæd læst naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 昨晚的馬路噪音很大嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only early, then the street went silent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ˈɜrli ðɛn ðə strit wɛnt ˈsaɪlənt/
dialogue.zh: 只有早一點的時候，之後街道就安靜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we keep this room next time?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi kip ðɪs rum nɛkst taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 下次我們可以住這間房嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask for four oh two when booking.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk fɔr fɔr oʊ tu wɛn ˈbʊkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 訂房時指定四零二房就可以了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you write our email once more?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl juː raɪt ˈaʊər ˈiːmeɪl wʌns mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 你可以再寫一次我們的電子郵件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is all lowercase, one short address.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɔl ˈloʊərkeɪs wʌn ʃɔrt əˈdrɛs/
dialogue.zh: 全部小寫，一個短短的地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this hotel have a quiet floor?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðɪs hoʊˈtɛl hæv ə ˈkwaɪət flɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 這間飯店有安靜樓層嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, and the fourth is quietest.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du ænd ðə fɔrθ ɪz ˈkwaɪətəst/
dialogue.zh: 有的，而四樓是最安靜的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we leave the guest a note?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi liv ðə ɡɛst ə noʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們該留張紙條給那位客人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a sweet thing to do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə swit θɪŋ tu du/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready to check out with a smile?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛdi tu tʃɛk aʊt wɪð ə smaɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 準備好帶著微笑退房了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am, that was the best sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ðæt wʌz ðə bɛst slip/
dialogue.zh: 準備好了，那是我睡得最好的一次。

issues.note: idx 312『Is the window safe to open?』→ idx 313『A little air would help us sleep.』未正面回應安全性，屬輕微答非所問；b 有實詞、非空心回應，不列 error。

同一聲部在 idx 390 仍以住客身分問『Can we keep this room next time?』（391 答『Ask for four oh two when booking.』），idx 396 卻說『Should we leave the guest a note?』把住客當第三人稱；本格式 char_a/char_b 為朗讀聲部、非固定角色，且非固定事實矛盾，不列 error。
idx 177 答『Only tomorrow morning works.』，idx 237 又答『we can move you tonight.』，換房時間說法鬆散；兩處相隔多對、屬短句庫通用答句，非樓層/金額等固定事實矛盾。
idx 137『a group took them all』與 idx 205『A big group took every twin room.』語意近重複（字面不同，機器未判整句重複）；另『Have you got…』起句全篇 12 次、b 以『Yes,』起句約 15 次，開頭變化度偏弱。

review.summary_zh: 四維皆無 error 級問題：無 b 空心回應、無 WH 問句被 Yes-No 回答、固定事實全篇一致（602 六樓、402 四樓、NT$3,100×3＝9,300、免押金、含早餐二樓七點、遮光窗簾、軟硬枕頭、雙床售罄後改訂雙人房）。本輪段 2 三處無新資訊的『Yes, …』（187/197/199）已改為直述，b 起句不再以 Yes 開頭，段內 Yes/No 起句比例降到 50% 以下。C 項依機器證據給分（hard 0、SUSPECT 0、逐詞 token 對齊通過），未自行複核音標。僅餘答非所問與開頭詞偏重複等風格項，已逐條具名合理化。
